audit_metadata.phase: Phase 4 — Environmental Data Source Feasibility Audit

boundary_reference.source_citation: geoBoundaries IND-ADM1-1811400 (DataMeet India community / Election Commission of India), CC BY 2.5 IN

primary_meteorological.official_name: ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present
primary_meteorological.spatial_resolution: 0.1° x 0.1° regular lat-lon (~11.1 km x 9.6 km at 30°N; native ~9 km TCo1279 grid)
primary_meteorological.latency: ~5 days preliminary (ERA5-Land-T); final validated release ~2-3 months later
primary_meteorological.auth_mechanism: Free CDS account, ~/.cdsapirc API key, and web UI dataset licence acceptance
critical_engineering_caveats: total_precipitation accumulates continuously from 00:00 UTC each day and resets at 00:00 UTC; must de-accumulate into hourly increments before computing IST-day totals or antecedent windows.

Relative humidity (RH) and Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD) are not directly stored in ERA5-Land; derive from 2m_temperature and 2m_dewpoint_temperature via Magnus-Tetens / Alduchov-Eskridge saturation vapor pressure equations.
Wind speed and meteorological direction must be derived from orthogonal 10m_u_component_of_wind and 10m_v_component_of_wind vectors.
High-altitude Himalayan border glaciers/snowpack and water masks require explicit NA/mask handling.
primary_meteorological.selection_rationale: At 582 intersecting cells across Uttarakhand (~20x more cells than NASA POWER's 28 intersecting cells), ERA5-Land captures sub-regional meteorological, soil moisture, and diurnal drying contrasts across foothill, middle-Himalayan pine belt, and high-altitude zones while offering full hourly UTC alignment and CC BY 4.0 licensing.

secondary_meteorological_validation.official_name: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) — MERRA-2 Meteorology
secondary_meteorological_validation.provider: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) / NASA GMAO
secondary_meteorological_validation.latency: ~3-5 days (up to ~2 weeks for selected parameters)
secondary_meteorological_validation.licence: NASA Open Data (public domain; attribution requested)
secondary_meteorological_validation.selection_rationale: Too coarse (17 cell centers inside Uttarakhand) for primary spatial modeling in extreme Himalayan terrain, but zero-auth API access and ready-computed RH2M make it ideal for independent sanity validation against ERA5-Land.

optional_precipitation_benchmarks.official_name: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 Daily 0.1° V07
optional_precipitation_benchmarks.licence: CC BY 4.0 / NASA Open Data Policy
optional_precipitation_benchmarks.role: Cross-check monsoon/dry-spell rainfall intensity and spatial structure against ERA5-Land

optional_precipitation_benchmarks.spatial_resolution: 0.05° x 0.05° (exact spacing match to FIREINTEL 0.05° common grid)
optional_precipitation_benchmarks.role: High-resolution 0.05° precipitation benchmark (noting high-Himalayan gauge sparsity and post-Dec-2026 transition to CHIRPS v3)

primary_vegetation.official_name: MODIS Terra (MOD13Q1 v061) + Aqua (MYD13Q1 v061) Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m SIN Grid
primary_vegetation.spatial_resolution: 250 m native Sinusoidal grid (sphere R = 6,371,007.181 m); reprojected to EPSG:4326 on AppEEARS
primary_vegetation.temporal_resolution: 16-day per platform; staggered Terra + Aqua phases provide ~8-day effective cadence
primary_vegetation.licence: NASA ESDS Open Data Policy (public domain / unrestricted; citation requested)
primary_vegetation.auth_mechanism: Free NASA Earthdata Login account (AppEEARS token)
variables_requested: 250m 16 days composite day of the year

continuity_cross_check_partner.official_name: Suomi NPP VIIRS Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 500m SIN Grid V002
continuity_cross_check_partner.role: Cross-check Terra/Aqua orbital drift bias (constellation exit 2020–2021) and provide long-term continuity pathway beyond scheduled Terra/Aqua retirement (late 2026–2027).

primary_vegetation.selection_rationale: 250 m native pixels resolve narrow Himalayan valley and ridge forest cover far better than 500 m alternatives (~400 pixels per 0.05° cell), while staggered MOD13Q1 + MYD13Q1 yields 8-day fuel greenness updates.

primary_terrain.official_name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Global 30m Digital Surface Model / COP30)
primary_terrain.provider: ESA / DLR & Airbus Defence and Space
primary_terrain.spatial_resolution: 1 arc-second (~30 m horizontal); EGM2008 orthometric vertical datum
primary_terrain.licence: Copernicus DEM Licence (free, full, and open access; requires © DLR e.V. and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH attribution)
primary_terrain.auth_note: No auth via AWS Open Data S3 (copernicus-dem-30m); free API key required for OpenTopography REST subsetting
derived_features: slope_mean_deg, slope_max_deg (computed after reprojection to EPSG:32644)
aspect_sin_mean, aspect_cos_mean (circular components computed in EPSG:32644)

benchmark_fallback.official_name: NASA SRTM Global 1 Arc Second V003
benchmark_fallback.notes: February 2000 Shuttle mission (EGM96 datum), public domain; acceptable fallback if COP30 attribution is undesired, but older and more susceptible to high-Himalayan C-band void-fill artifacts.

excluded_from_mvp_baseline.reason: Optional exploratory only. MODIS LST suffers severe cloud-cover gaps during Uttarakhand winter disturbances and pre-monsoon storms, measures surface skin temperature rather than 2m air temperature, and exhibits overpass-time thermal drift due to post-2020/2021 Terra/Aqua orbital drift.

relative_humidity.primary_source: Derived from ERA5-Land (2m_temperature and 2m_dewpoint_temperature via saturation vapor pressure ratio; also yields VPD)

precipitation_rainfall.primary_source: ERA5-Land (total_precipitation, de-accumulated from 00:00 UTC reset -> mm/hr -> mm/IST-day and 3/7/14-day antecedents)
precipitation_rainfall.secondary_check: NASA POWER (PRECTOTCORR), GPM_3IMERGDF v07, or CHIRPS v2.0

wind_direction.primary_source: Derived from ERA5-Land atan2(-u10, -v10) encoded cyclically as sin(theta), cos(theta) or u10/v10 components

soil_moisture.primary_source: ERA5-Land volumetric_soil_water_layer_1 (0-7 cm), layer_2 (7-28 cm), layer_3 (28-100 cm) in m³/m³
soil_moisture.secondary_check: NASA POWER (GWETTOP 0-5 cm, GWETROOT unitless wetness)

ndvi.primary_source: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 + MYD13Q1 v061 (250 m, 16-day staggered ~8-day, QA-masked)

evi.primary_source: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 + MYD13Q1 v061 (250 m, 16-day staggered ~8-day, QA-masked; reduces high-biomass saturation)

elevation.primary_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (30 m, EGM2008 zonal stats per 0.05° cell)

slope_and_aspect.primary_source: Derived from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 after reprojection to EPSG:32644 (UTM Zone 44N); aspect encoded via circular sin/cos means

common_grid.grid_origin_rule: SW cell corner = floor(coord / 0.05) * 0.05 (matches existing FIREINTEL Phase 2/3 eda.py convention)
common_grid.resampling_safeguard: Each 0.05° cell inherits weather from its containing 0.1° ERA5-Land cell (whose coordinates denote cell centers, so cell boundaries +/-0.05° split cleanly into 2x2 sub-cells of 0.05°) with explicit resolution provenance metadata; never falsely claim sub-0.1° atmospheric precision from spatial interpolation alone.

temporal_contract.storage_timezone: UTC (preserving existing FIRMS acq_datetime ISO-8601 UTC schema)
temporal_contract.strict_causality_rule: At prediction issue timestamp T0, all weather antecedents, meteorological summaries, rolling precipitation totals, and 16-day MODIS/VIIRS vegetation composites must have composite end timestamps + latency strictly <= T0.
